how_to_edit: Goals that permanently unlock things. Items listed in an unlock's reward stay out of chests, shops and drops until it is earned.

condition types: kills (lifetime kills of a family: sporeling, bandit, wolf, beast, any), kills_in_run (in one expedition), clear (defeat a dungeon's guardian; optional class, max_seconds, max_potions, holding an item id), clears (total clears), deaths (adventurers lost), bounties (bounties completed), reach (enter a dungeon).
reward: items (list of item ids), drop_luck (adds to the drop luck multiplier, 0.15 = +15%), bounty_slots (extra bounties on the board).
hint is what the Hearth shows before it is earned; name and text after.
